title: I guess I'm married
content: So I've dreamt about the same classrooms and teachers and students for years, but they've been different lately. The teacher's child is a student in class who sits behind me, and I guess she's my wife. The student body is upset with me for forgetting about her, and I can't go anywhere without being reminded of my wife. Like, there's this alien looking but fleshy dwarf guy who acts like he's from Detroit that I commonly see, and he's furious with me because I forgot about my wife. I am sure my subconscious is trying to tell me something, but I haven't ever been married, not that I can remember anyway. What am I forgetting?!? Also, I'm always seeing different versions of myself in my dreams and I just gotta say that the characters are just always so funny.
